test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six persons – L, M, N, O, P and Q – are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order. O is sitting second to the left of Q. P is not an immediate neighbour of Q. M is sitting second to the right of L. N is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

Who is an immediate neighbour of both, L and N?
solution:
Given: Six persons – L, M, N, O, P and Q – are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order.

O is sitting second to the left of Q. P is not an immediate neighbour of Q.

M is sitting second to the right of L. N is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d6c7a7ddf3665d4ef13882bffdf5b6db8139da9bbbb858082330ece4f60792.png] 

Thus, P is an immediate neighbour of both, L and N.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
